svg.title: MoveIt 2 architecture
svg.desc: A block diagram. A skill goal goes to MoveItPy, which calls MoveItCpp; both sit inside a dashed box marked tag 1. MoveItCpp sends the request into the planning pipeline, tag 2: request adapters, then a planner (OMPL or Pilz), then response adapters. A planning scene block, tag 3, feeds the planner. The result goes to trajectory execution, which sends it to the ARIAC joint trajectory controller outside the dashed box. A separate dashed block on the left, move_group node, is marked tag 4 and has no arrows.
